compute distance of point from line segment, or
Double.MAX_VALUE if perpendicular projection is outside segment; or
If pts on line are same, return distance from point
properties.description: Calculates the distance from a point to a line segment in a 2D space.
properties.howItWorks: Calculates the distance from a point to a line segment using the formula for the perpendicular distance from a point to a line. It first checks if the line is degenerate (i.e., parallel or coincident) and returns the length of the line segment in that case. Otherwise, it calculates the intersection point of the perpendicular from the point to the line and then computes the distance between the point and this intersection point.
properties.howToUse: Call with six integer arguments representing the coordinates of the two endpoints of the line segment and the point.
postConditions: The returned value is a non-negative double representing the distance from the point to the line segment.
preConditions: All input values must be valid integers.
properties.returns: The distance from the point (xc, yc) to the line segment defined by points (xa, ya) and (xb, yb).

properties.howItWorks: This method first retrieves the bounding rectangle of the figure with an additional border using the displayBox() method. It then calls the draw method of its contained figure to render it. After that, it sets the color to white and draws lines at the top and left edges of the rectangle to create a border. Next, it sets the color to gray and draws lines at the bottom and right edges of the rectangle to complete the border.
properties.howToUse: Call the draw method with a Graphics object to render the figure.
postConditions: The figure is rendered on the graphics context with an additional border.
preConditions: The displayBox() method returns the bounding rectangle of the figure with an additional border added to it.

properties.description: Calculates the closest point on a polygon to a given point.
properties.howItWorks: The method calculates the center of the polygon and then iterates through each edge of the polygon to find the intersection point with the line connecting the given point to the center. If an intersection is found, it checks if the distance between the intersection point and the given point is shorter than the current shortest distance. If so, it updates the closest point. If no intersection is found, it calculates the distance from the given point to each vertex of the polygon and returns the vertex with the smallest distance.
properties.howToUse: Call chop(poly, p) to get the closest point on a polygon to a given point.

A ConnectionFigure can have multiple segments. It provides operations to split and join segments.

Design Patterns

Strategy
Strategy is used encapsulate the algorithm to locate the connection point. ConnectionFigure is the Strategy context and Connector is the Strategy.
Observer
Observer is used to track changes of the connected figures. A connection figure registers itself as listeners or observers of the source and target connector.

@see Connector

methods.name: add(CH.ifa.draw.framework.FigureChangeListener, CH.ifa.draw.framework.FigureChangeListener)

methods.description: Handles changes to figures in a drawing application.
methods.howToUse: Called when a figure is changed in the drawing application.

methods.howToUse: Called when a figure's state changes and needs to be redrawn.

methods.description: Handles the removal of a figure from the drawing area.
methods.howToUse: Called when a figure is removed from the drawing area.
methods.howItWorks: The method iterates over two listeners (a and b) of type CH.ifa.draw.framework.FigureChangeListener, and calls their figureRemoved method with the provided event.

methods.description: Handles the removal of a figure from the drawing area.
methods.howToUse: Called when a figure is removed from the drawing area.
methods.howItWorks: The method iterates over two listeners (a and b) of type CH.ifa.draw.framework.FigureChangeListener, calling their figureRequestRemove method with the provided FigureChangeEvent e.

methods.name: figureRequestUpdate(CH.ifa.draw.framework.FigureChangeEvent)
methods.description: Handles updates to figure changes in the drawing framework.
methods.howToUse: Called when a figure's properties or layout is updated.
methods.howItWorks: The method iterates over two listeners (a and b) of type CH.ifa.draw.framework.FigureChangeListener and calls their figureRequestUpdate method with the provided FigureChangeEvent.

methods.description: Removes a FigureChangeListener from the multicaster.
methods.returns: A new FigureChangeEventMulticaster instance containing the remaining listeners or this if no listeners remain.
methods.howToUse: Call removeInternal with a FigureChangeListener instance to remove it from the multicaster.
methods.howItWorks: The method checks if either listener is null. If so, it returns the non-null listener. Otherwise, it creates a new FigureChangeEventMulticaster instance containing both listeners.

properties.docComment: Sends a figure to the back of the drawing.
properties.description: The sendToBack method moves a figure to the back of the composite figure's list.
properties.howItWorks:
1. Checks if the figure is in the composite figure's list.
2. Removes the figure from the list.
3. Inserts the figure at the beginning of the list.
4. Calls the changed method on the figure to notify listeners.

properties.description: Handles the disconnection of two figures in a PertDependency diagram by removing pre-tasks from the target figure and updating its durations.
properties.howItWorks: The method first casts the start and end figures to PertFigure objects. It then checks if the target figure is not null, removes the source figure as a pre-task from the target figure, updates the target figure's durations, and finally checks if the source figure is not null, removing the target figure as a post-task from the source figure.
properties.howToUse: Call handleDisconnect with two PertFigure objects to remove pre-tasks from the target figure and update its durations.
postConditions: The pre-tasks of the target figure have been removed, and its durations have been updated.
preConditions: start and end are valid PertFigure objects

properties.docComment: Creates the color choice for the given attribute.

properties.docComment: Sets the end point.
properties.description: The endPoint method in CH.ifa.draw.figures.LineConnection updates the end point of a line connection and notifies listeners about changes.
properties.howItWorks: The method first calls willChange() to notify listeners about potential changes. It then checks if there are less than two points in the fPoints list. If so, it adds a new Point with the given x and y coordinates to the end of the list. Otherwise, it updates the last point in the list with the new coordinates. Finally, it calls changed() to notify listeners about the change.
properties.howToUse: Called when the end point of a line connection needs to be updated.
postConditions: The end point of the line connection has been updated.
Listeners have been notified about the change.
preConditions: The method is called with valid integer values for x and y.

properties.docComment: Returns a Clone of this figure
properties.description: The clone() method creates a copy of the current Figure object.
properties.howItWorks: The clone() method creates a new instance of the Figure class and copies all its properties, including nested objects. This ensures that the copied object is independent of the original.
properties.howToUse: Call the clone() method on any Figure object to create a copy.
postConditions: A new Figure object is created with the same properties as the original.
properties.returns: A new instance of the Figure class that is a deep copy of the original.

properties.docComment:
Freezes the view by acquiring the drawing lock.

@see Drawing#lock
properties.description: The freezeView() method locks the drawing object in CH.ifa.draw.standard.StandardDrawingView.
properties.howItWorks: The freezeView() method calls the lock() method on the drawing object returned by the drawing() method. The lock() method acquires a lock on the drawing object, preventing any changes from being made until the lock is released.
properties.howToUse: Call the freezeView() method on an instance of StandardDrawingView to lock the drawing object.

properties.docComment: Handles mouse drag events in the drawing view.
properties.description: Handles mouse drag events in the CH.ifa.draw.standard.DragTracker class.
properties.howItWorks: The method first calls super.mouseDrag(e, x, y) to handle the default behavior of the superclass. It then checks if the figure has moved by comparing the current position with the anchor position. If it has moved, it retrieves all selected figures from the drawing view and moves each one by the difference in x and y coordinates. Finally, it updates the last x and y positions.
properties.howToUse: Called when a mouse drag event occurs within the DragTracker class.

properties.description: Returns the name of a tool button.
properties.howItWorks: The method returns the value stored in the field `fName` of the ToolButton object.
properties.howToUse: Call the method `name()` on an instance of `CH.ifa.draw.standard.ToolButton`.
properties.returns: A string representing the name of the tool button.

The x-coordinate of the anchor point.

properties.docComment:
Constrains the given point.

@return constrained point.
properties.description: The method constrainPoint(java.awt.Point) is a mutator that takes a java.awt.Point object and returns a modified version of it based on the constraints defined by the PointConstrainer interface.
properties.howItWorks: This method modifies the input point to ensure it adheres to certain constraints, such as staying within the bounds of a drawing area or ensuring it is not too close to another point. The exact implementation details depend on the specific requirements and design of the application.
properties.howToUse: The PointConstrainer interface should be implemented by any class that needs to constrain points in a drawing environment. Developers can then use this method to apply constraints to their points.
postConditions: The returned point should be modified to adhere to the constraints defined by the PointConstrainer interface.
properties.returns: A java.awt.Point object that has been constrained based on the input point and the constraints defined by the PointConstrainer interface.

methods.howItWorks: The method first checks if the fTextField is null and initializes it if necessary. The method creates an overlay for the figure using its font, sets the bounds and text of the floating text field, and updates the typing target.

methods.name: endEdit

methods.docComment: Ends the editing process for a text tool in JHotDraw-5.1.
methods.howToUse: Call endEdit() on an instance of TextTool to end the editing process.
methods.howItWorks: The method checks if fTypingTarget is not null, then checks if the text in fTextField is not empty. If so, it updates the text of fTypingTarget with the text from fTextField. If no text is entered, it removes fTypingTarget from the drawing and ends the overlay. Finally, it sets fTypingTarget to null and calls checkDamage() on the view.

The Iconkit class supports the sharing of images. It maintains a map of image names and their corresponding images. Iconkit also supports to load a collection of images in synchronized way. The resolution of a path name to an image is delegated to the DrawingEditor.

Singleton

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Loads an image from the classpath and caches it for future use.
methods.docComment: Loads an image with the given name.  @see #registerImage.
methods.returns: A java.awt.Image object representing the loaded image, or null if an exception occurs.
methods.howToUse: Call loadImage with a resource name as a string argument to load an image from the classpath.
methods.howItWorks: The method first checks if the image is already in the cache. If it is, it returns the cached image. Otherwise, it loads the image using loadImageResource and caches it before returning it.

methods.name: loadImageResource
methods.description: Loads an image resource from the classpath.
methods.returns: A java.awt.Image object representing the loaded image, or null if an exception occurs.
methods.howToUse: Call loadImageResource with a resource name as a string argument to load an image from the classpath.
methods.howItWorks: The method retrieves the URL of the resource using this.getClass().getResource(resourcename), creates an ImageProducer from the content of the URL, and then uses toolkit.createImage() to create an Image object. If an exception occurs during the process, it returns null.

methods.name: loadRegisteredImages
methods.description: Loads registered images into a component using a media tracker.
methods.docComment: Loads all registered images.  @see #registerImage.
methods.howToUse: Call loadRegisteredImages with a java.awt.Component object to load registered images.
methods.howItWorks: The method first checks if there are any registered images. If not, it returns immediately. It then creates a MediaTracker for the component and iterates over the registered image filenames. For each filename, it checks if the image is already loaded using basicGetImage. If not, it adds the image to the tracker and loads it using loadImage. After loading all images, it removes them from the registered images list and waits for all images to be loaded.

methods.name: registerAndLoadImage
methods.description: Registers an image file name to a list of registered images and then loads all registered images into a component.
methods.docComment: Registers and loads an image.  @see #loadRegisteredImages.
methods.returns: A java.awt.Image object or null if the filename is not found in the map.
methods.howToUse: Call registerAndLoadImage with a java.awt.Component and a string representing the filename to register and load the image.
methods.howItWorks: The method first registers the image file name using the registerImage method, then loads all registered images into the component using the loadRegisteredImages method, and finally retrieves the image using the getImage method.

methods.name: registerImage
methods.description: Registers an image file name to a list of registered images. The image is then loaded together with the other registered images by loadRegisteredImages.
methods.docComment: Registers an image that is then loaded together with the other registered images by loadRegisteredImages.  @see #loadRegisteredImages.
methods.howToUse: Call registerImage with the file name as an argument.
methods.howItWorks: Adds the provided file name to a list of registered images.

properties.description: Handles mouse drag events on a palette button and updates its state accordingly.
properties.howItWorks: Checks if the mouse is within the bounds of the palette button. If so, sets its state to PRESSED; otherwise, resets it to its previous state and repaints the button.

The button is repainted to reflect the new state.

properties.description: Draws the background of a round rectangle figure using the provided graphics context.

properties.docComment: Gets the minimum dimension of the drawing.
Shows a file dialog and saves drawing.
properties.description: Prompts the user to save a drawing application with a specified file path.
properties.howItWorks: The method first calls toolDone() to set the current tool in the application. It then prompts the user to enter a file path using getSavePath(). If a valid path is provided, it checks if the file extension is '.draw'. If not, it appends '.draw' to the path. Finally, it saves the drawing to the specified file path using saveAsStorableOutput().
properties.howToUse: Call promptSaveAs() to open a save dialog and save the drawing application.
postConditions: The drawing application is saved to a file with the specified name.
The current tool in the application remains unchanged.
preConditions: The application must be initialized and running.

properties.description: Reads an object from an ObjectInputStream and updates the text figure's observed figure if it exists.
properties.howItWorks: The method reads the default state of the object using s.defaultReadObject(). If the fObservedFigure is not null, it adds this TextFigure as a listener to the observed figure. Finally, it marks the text figure as dirty.
properties.howToUse: Call readObject with an ObjectInputStream instance to deserialize and update the text figure's state.
postConditions: The text figure's observed figure, if it exists, is added as a listener to the observed figure.
preConditions: The method has been called with an ObjectInputStream instance.

properties.description: The outline method generates a polygon shape for an arrow tip based on the given x and y coordinates and direction.
properties.howItWorks: The method creates a new Polygon object, adds points relative to its center at specified radii and angles based on the given direction.
properties.howToUse: Call outline with x, y coordinates and direction to get the arrow tip polygon.
postConditions: A java.awt.Polygon object is returned representing the arrow tip shape.
preConditions: x and y should be valid integer values representing the position of the arrow tip.
properties.returns: A java.awt.Polygon object representing the arrow tip shape.

properties.docComment:
A tool defines a mode of the drawing view. All input events targeted to the drawing view are forwarded to its current tool.

Tools inform their editor when they are done with an interaction by calling the editor's toolDone() method. The Tools are created once and reused. They are initialized/deinitialized with activate()/deactivate().

Design Patterns

State
Tool plays the role of the State. In encapsulates all state specific behavior. DrawingView plays the role of the StateContext. @see DrawingView
properties.description: The CH.ifa.draw.framework.Tool interface defines methods for handling user interactions in a drawing application, such as activating and deactivating the tool, processing key down events, mouse down, drag, move, and up events.

properties.description: The release() method in the CH.ifa.draw.figures.LineConnection class is responsible for releasing a line connection by disconnecting it from its start and end figures and removing any registered figure change listeners.
properties.howItWorks: The method first calls super.release() to ensure that any registered FigureChangeListener is notified. properties.description: The disconnectEnd() method in the CH.ifa.draw.figures.LineConnection class handles the disconnection of a line connection by removing it from its start and end figures.
properties.howItWorks: The method first calls handleDisconnect to notify any listeners about the disconnection. It then removes itself as a figure change listener from the end figure, ensuring that no further updates are received for this connection. Finally, it sets fEnd to null to indicate that there is no end figure associated with this line connection.
properties.howToUse: Call disconnectEnd() on an instance of LineConnection to remove it from its start and end figures.
postConditions: The line connection has been disconnected from its start and end figures.
The current instance of LineConnection will not receive any further updates for this connection.

preConditions: The LineConnection instance must have been properly initialized and connected.

properties.description: Loads a drawing from a specified file in the CH.ifa.draw.applet.DrawApplet application.
properties.howItWorks: If the provided filename is CH.ifa.draw.applet.DrawApplet.fgUntitled, it releases the current drawing and initializes a new one. Otherwise, it reads the drawing from the specified file.

properties.description: Inserts a point at a specified index in the polygon figure.
properties.howItWorks: The method first notifies listeners about invalidation events and updates the display box of the figure. It then creates new arrays for x and y coordinates, copies existing points up to the insertion index, inserts the new point, and finally updates the polygon figure with the new coordinates.
properties.howToUse: Called when a point needs to be inserted into the polygon figure at a specific index.
postConditions: The polygon figure has been updated with the new point at index i.
preConditions: p is a valid java.awt.Point object
i is an integer within the range of 0 to fPoly.npoints

properties.description: The border() method returns a new Point object with coordinates (3, 3). It is used to define the border of a figure in the JHotDraw-5.1 framework.
properties.howItWorks: The method creates a new Point object with x and y coordinates set to 3 using the constructor java.awt.Point(int x, int y). This point represents the top-left corner of the border of the figure.
properties.howToUse: This method is called within the CH.ifa.draw.figures.BorderDecorator class to define the border of a figure in the JHotDraw-5.1 framework.
postConditions: A new Point object with coordinates (3, 3) is returned.
properties.returns: A java.awt.Point object representing the top-left corner of the border of a figure.

properties.description: Handles the step operation for a drawing view in JHotDraw-5.1.
properties.howItWorks: This method handles the step operation for a drawing view in JHotDraw-5.1. It takes four integer parameters representing the mouse click coordinates and an instance of DrawingView as input, and performs the necessary operations to update the drawing view based on these inputs.
properties.howToUse: Call this method with the necessary parameters to perform a step operation on the specified drawing view.

postConditions.condition: The drawing view has been updated based on the step operation.
No exceptions have been thrown during the execution of the method.

preConditions.condition: The provided DrawingView object is not null.
The x-coordinate and y-coordinate are valid integers.
The anchorX and anchorY coordinates are valid integers.

properties.description: The duration() method returns the integer value of a figure index from a NumberTextFigure.
properties.howItWorks: The method asInt(int) is called within the duration() method, which converts a figure index to its corresponding integer value from a NumberTextFigure.
properties.howToUse: Call duration() with an integer index to get the corresponding integer value.
postConditions: The returned integer value represents the parsed value from the text content of the NumberTextFigure.
preConditions: A valid integer index must be provided.
properties.returns: An integer representing the parsed value from the text content of the NumberTextFigure.

properties.description: Executes a command to change the attribute of selected figures in a drawing view.
properties.howItWorks: The method iterates over all selected figures, retrieves each figure using selectionElements(), and sets its attribute using setAttribute(). After setting attributes for all selected figures, it calls checkDamage() to handle any accumulated damage.
properties.howToUse: Call execute() to change the attribute of selected figures in a drawing view.
postConditions: All selected figures have their attribute changed according to the provided fAttribute and fValue.
The drawing view's damage status is checked after all changes are made.
preConditions: A CH.ifa.draw.framework.DrawingView object is instantiated and has at least one selected figure.

properties.docComment:
Releases a figure's resources. Release is called when
a figure is removed from a drawing. Informs the listeners that
the figure is removed by calling figureRemoved.
properties.description: The release() method releases the figure from its current context.
properties.howItWorks: The release() method typically involves cleaning up any references held by the figure, releasing any locks or handles, and ensuring that the figure is no longer in use by other components.
properties.howToUse: Call the release() method on a Figure object to free it from any associated resources or contexts.
postConditions: The figure is released from its current context.
Any associated resources are freed.

properties.description: The findConnector method returns a Connector object at the specified coordinates (x, y). It is used to find or create a connection point on a figure.
properties.howItWorks: The method calls the connectorAt method of the Figure object with the given x and y coordinates to return the Connector object at that location.
properties.howToUse: The findConnector method is typically called by other methods in the CH.ifa.draw.framework.Figure interface to find or create a connection point on a figure.
properties.returns: A Connector object representing the connection point at the specified coordinates.

properties.docComment:
Splits the segment at the given point if a segment was hit.

@return the index of the segment or -1 if no segment was hit.
properties.description: The method splitSegment(int,int) inserts a point at the closest segment in a polygon to a given point and returns the index of the new segment.
properties.howItWorks: The method first finds the closest segment to the given point using the findSegment(int,int) method. If a segment is found, it inserts a new point at the specified index in the polygon figure and returns the index of the new segment. If no segment is found, it returns -1.
properties.howToUse: Call with two integer arguments representing the x and y coordinates of the point.
postConditions: If a segment is found, the method inserts a new point at the specified index in the polygon figure and returns the index of the new segment. If no segment is found, it returns -1.
The polygon figure remains unchanged if no segment is found.
preConditions: The input parameters x and y are valid integers.
properties.returns: The index of the new segment or -1 if no segment was hit.

properties.description: Determines if two points are vertically aligned.
properties.howItWorks: The method checks if the x-coordinates of both points are equal, which determines vertical alignment.
properties.howToUse: Call isVertical with two Point objects to check if they are vertically aligned.
postConditions: Returns true if p1 and p2 are vertically aligned; false otherwise.
preConditions: Both p1 and p2 must be instances of java.awt.Point.
properties.returns: A boolean indicating whether the two points are vertically aligned.

properties.docComment: Finds a connection start figure.
properties.description: The findConnectionStart method searches for a connectable figure at the specified coordinates within the drawing and returns it if it can be connected.
properties.howItWorks: The method first calls findConnectableFigure to locate a connectable figure at the specified coordinates within the drawing. If a connectable figure is found, it checks if it can be connected using the canConnect() method. If both conditions are met, it returns the connectable figure; otherwise, it returns null.

properties.docComment: Finds a figure but descends into a figure's children. Use this method to implement click-through hit detection, that is, you want to detect the inner most figure containing the given point.
properties.description: The method findFigureInside(int x, int y) is declared within the abstract class CH.ifa.draw.standard.CompositeFigure and returns a Figure object representing the figure found at the specified coordinates.
properties.howItWorks: This method iterates over all figures in the composite figure in reverse order using a FigureEnumeration. For each figure, it calls findFigureInside(int x, int y) to check if the figure contains the given point. If a figure is found that contains the point, it returns that figure; otherwise, it returns null.
properties.howToUse: Call findFigureInside(int x, int y) on an instance of CompositeFigure to retrieve a figure from the drawing framework based on its position.

postConditions.condition: Returns a Figure object if a figure containing the specified point is found, otherwise returns null.

preConditions.condition: x and y are valid integer values representing coordinates within the drawing framework.

properties.returns: A Figure object representing the figure found at the specified coordinates or null if no figure is found.

Finally, it returns an Enumeration of the elements in fSelectionHandles.

properties.description: The basicDisplayBox method translates the polygon figure to a new position based on the origin and corner points.
properties.howItWorks: The method first calculates the current display box of the polygon using this.displayBox(). It then translates the polygon by subtracting the origin's x and y coordinates from the display box's x and y coordinates. The translated polygon is then scaled and rotated around a new corner point using the scaleRotate method.

properties.docComment:
The interface of a graphical figure. A figure knows its display box and can draw itself. A figure can be composed of several figures. To interact and manipulate with a figure it can provide Handles and Connectors.

A figure has a set of handles to manipulate its shape or attributes. A figure has one or more connectors that define how to locate a connection point.

Figures can have an open ended set of attributes. An attribute is identified by a string.

Default implementations for the Figure interface are provided by AbstractFigure. @see Handle @see Connector @see AbstractFigure

		the palette where the tools are added.

properties.docComment:
Replaces a figure in the drawing without
removing it from the drawing.
properties.description: Replaces a figure in the composite figure with a new replacement figure.
properties.howItWorks: Finds the index of the figure in the composite figure's list, adds the replacement figure to the container, notifies all listeners of changes to the figure, updates the figure's display box, and sets the replacement figure at the found index.
properties.howToUse: Call replace with the figure to be replaced and the replacement figure.
postConditions: The figure is replaced with the replacement figure.
All listeners are notified of changes to the figure.
The figure's display box is updated.

properties.docComment:
Informs that the current selection changed.
By default this event is forwarded to the
drawing editor.
properties.description: Handles changes in the selection within a drawing view.
properties.howItWorks: The method calls the selectionChanged method of the DrawingEditor with itself as an argument.
properties.howToUse: Called when the selection in the drawing view changes.

properties.description: Writes a CH.ifa.draw.util.StorableOutput object to the given CH.ifa.draw.util.StorableOutput.
properties.howItWorks: The method writes a CH.ifa.draw.util.StorableOutput object to the given CH.ifa.draw.util.StorableOutput by calling super.write(dw), writing the size of the points, iterating over each point and writing its x and y coordinates, writing the start and end decorations, and finally writing the frame color.
properties.howToUse: Call write(CH.ifa.draw.util.StorableOutput dw) with an instance of StorableOutput as the parameter.
postConditions: The CH.ifa.draw.util.StorableOutput object has been written to the given CH.ifa.draw.util.StorableOutput.

properties.docComment:
Handles mouse drag events. The events are forwarded to the
current tracker.

properties.howItWorks: The method checks if there is a child tool and then calls its mouseDrag method with the provided MouseEvent, x, and y coordinates.
properties.howToUse: Called when the user drags a mouse in the drawing area.

preConditions.condition: this.fChild != null
preConditions.description: The child tool is not null.

properties.description: Handles the start of a radius handle in a drawing view.
properties.howItWorks: The method calculates the arc width and height of the owner figure (RoundRectangleFigure), then halves these values to set the new radius for the handle.
properties.howToUse: Call invokeStart(int x, int y, CH.ifa.draw.framework.DrawingView view) on an instance of RadiusHandle to start a radius handle.

postConditions.condition: The radius handle's arc width and height are set to half the original values.
postConditions.description: The new radius for the handle is calculated and applied.

postConditions.condition: The method does not modify any other state or properties of the RadiusHandle instance.
postConditions.description: The method only modifies its own internal state.

preConditions.condition: x is a valid integer representing the x-coordinate where the radius handle starts.
preConditions.description: The x-coordinate must be within the bounds of the drawing view.

preConditions.condition: y is a valid integer representing the y-coordinate where the radius handle starts.
preConditions.description: The y-coordinate must be within the bounds of the drawing view.

preConditions.condition: view is an instance of DrawingView and is not null.
preConditions.description: The drawing view must be properly initialized and not null.

properties.docComment: Handles mouse up in the drawing view.
properties.description: Handles mouse up events in the drawing tool.
properties.howItWorks: Captures the mouse event and coordinates, then processes them to update the drawing state.
properties.howToUse: Called when the mouse is released while over a drawing tool.
postConditions: The drawing tool's state should be updated based on the mouse release event.
preConditions: The method should be called with valid MouseEvent and integer parameters.

properties.docComment:
Sets the default tool of the editor.

@see DrawingEditor
properties.description: Sets the current tool in a drawing application and updates the status bar.
properties.howItWorks: This method sets the current tool by calling the `tool()` method on the default tool button to get the tool object and then calls the `setSelected` method of the DrawApplet class to update the selected tool. It also updates the status bar with the name of the tool.
properties.howToUse: Call setTool(CH.ifa.draw.framework.Tool, java.lang.String) with a Tool object and its corresponding name to set the current tool in the drawing application.

properties.docComment: Returns the start point of the connection.

properties.howItWorks: The method returns the value returned by the fConnection.startPoint() method, which is a getter for the start point of the connection figure.
properties.howToUse: Call startPoint() on an instance of ConnectionFigure to get its starting point.
properties.returns: A java.awt.Point object representing the starting point of the connection figure.

properties.description: The guessType method determines the type of a file based on its extension.
properties.howItWorks: The method checks if the file ends with '.draw' and returns 'storable', '.ser' for 'serialized', and 'unknown' otherwise.
properties.howToUse: Call guessType with a file path to determine its type.
postConditions: Returns a string indicating the type of the file.
preConditions: A valid string representing a file path is provided.
properties.returns: A string indicating whether the file is 'storable', 'serialized', or 'unknown'.

properties.docComment: Draws this handle.
properties.description: This method draws a green rectangle around the bounding box of the handle.
properties.howItWorks: The method first retrieves the display box of the handle using the displayBox() method. It then sets the color to green and fills the rectangle with that color, followed by setting the color back to black and drawing the outline of the rectangle.
properties.howToUse: Call this method with a Graphics object to draw the handle on the screen.

properties.description: Instantiates a NorthEastHandle object with the given Figure owner.
properties.howItWorks: The constructor initializes the NorthEastHandle with the given Figure owner and sets it to use the north-east locator.
properties.howToUse: Create an instance of NorthEastHandle by passing a Figure object to its constructor.

postConditions.description: An instance of NorthEastHandle with the specified owner and north-east locator.

preConditions.description: A valid Figure object.

properties.returns: An instance of NorthEastHandle with the specified owner.

properties.description: This method calculates the bounds of a URLTool's display box based on the figure's display box and the length of its URL.
properties.howItWorks: The method calculates the bounds of the URLTool's display box by first getting the display box of the provided figure, then determining the number of characters in the URL attribute of the figure, and finally adjusting the position and size of the display box based on these calculations.
properties.howToUse: Call fieldBounds(CH.ifa.draw.framework.Figure figure) with a Figure object to get its display box bounds.
postConditions: The method returns a java.awt.Rectangle object representing the bounds of the URLTool's display box.
preConditions: The provided figure object must be a valid CH.ifa.draw.framework.Figure instance.

properties.description: The constructor initializes a RoundRectangleFigure object with an origin and corner point.
properties.howItWorks: The constructor sets the origin and corner points of the RoundRectangleFigure object. It also initializes the arc width and height to the default value.
properties.howToUse: Call the constructor with the desired origin and corner points to create a RoundRectangleFigure object.

postConditions.description: A new instance of RoundRectangleFigure is created.

properties.docComment:
Handles a user selection in the palette.

@see PaletteListener
properties.description: Handles user interactions by setting the selected tool in a DrawApplet and updating its state.
properties.howItWorks: The method retrieves the name and tool object from the PaletteButton, sets the current tool using the setTool() method, and updates the selected tool using setSelected().
properties.howToUse: Call paletteUserSelected(CH.ifa.draw.util.PaletteButton) with an instance of CH.ifa.draw.util.PaletteButton to set the selected tool in a DrawApplet.
postConditions: The selected tool in the DrawApplet is updated.
The status bar is updated to reflect the new tool.
preConditions: An instance of CH.ifa.draw.util.PaletteButton is provided.

properties.description: Handles the instantiation of FontSizeHandle objects and sets their owner.
properties.howItWorks: The constructor initializes the FontSizeHandle with the given owner and locator, which are used to manage the handle's position and behavior within the drawing framework.
properties.howToUse: Create an instance of FontSizeHandle by passing a Figure object and a Locator to its constructor.

postConditions.description: An instance of FontSizeHandle is created with the specified owner and locator.

preConditions.description: A valid Figure object must be provided.
A valid Locator object must be provided.

properties.returns: An instance of FontSizeHandle with the specified owner.

properties.description: Adds a figure to the drawing if it is not already present and wraps it in an AnimationDecorator.
properties.howItWorks: Checks if the figure is an instance of AnimationDecorator. If not, it wraps the figure in an AnimationDecorator. Then, it calls the superclass's add method to add the figure to the drawing.
properties.howToUse: Call add with a Figure instance.
postConditions: The added figure is returned, wrapped in an AnimationDecorator if necessary.
preConditions: The figure must be an instance of CH.ifa.draw.framework.Figure.

properties.description: Gets the save path for a drawing application based on the provided title.

properties.howToUse: Call setContents with an Object as its parameter to update the clipboard's contents.
postConditions: The Clipboard's internal state is updated with the new contents.
preConditions: A valid Object is passed as the argument.

properties.howToUse: Call endPoint with the desired x and y coordinates to set the end point of a connection figure.

properties.description: The deactivate() method removes a ScribbleTool from the drawing if its size is less than 4x4 pixels.
properties.howItWorks: The method first calls super.deactivate() to ensure proper deactivation of the tool. It then checks if fScribble is not null, and if so, it checks if its size is less than 4x4 pixels. If true, it removes fScribble from the drawing.
properties.howToUse: Call deactivate() on an instance of CH.ifa.draw.standard.AbstractTool to deactivate the tool and remove ScribbleTool from the drawing if its size is less than 4x4 pixels.
postConditions: If fScribble is not null and its size is less than 4x4 pixels, it will be removed from the drawing.

properties.description: Removes the component from its container and returns the component.
properties.howItWorks: The method removes the component from its container and returns the component.

this.fComponent is returned

The readObject method reads a serialized CompositeFigure object from an ObjectInputStream and reconstructs the figure hierarchy.
properties.howItWorks: The method first reads the default state of the CompositeFigure using s.defaultReadObject(). Then, it retrieves an enumeration of all figures in the current figure hierarchy using this.figures(). It iterates over each figure and adds it to the container using figure.addToContainer(this).
properties.howToUse: Call readObject with an ObjectInputStream instance that contains a serialized CompositeFigure object.
postConditions: The current CompositeFigure instance will have all figures read from the stream added to its container.
The method modifies the current CompositeFigure instance in place.
preConditions: The ObjectInputStream instance must contain a serialized CompositeFigure object.
properties.returns: Void. The method modifies the current CompositeFigure instance by adding all figures read from the stream to its container.

properties.description: The draw method is responsible for rendering the drawing view onto a graphics context.
properties.howItWorks: This method takes a Graphics object and a DrawingView object as parameters, and uses them to render the drawing view onto the graphics context. It iterates over all the shapes in the drawing view and calls their paint method with the provided graphics context.
properties.howToUse: The draw method should be called whenever the drawing needs to be updated or redrawn.

properties.description: Handles the creation of handles for a line connection in the PertDependency class.
properties.howItWorks: The method first calls super.handles() to get the default handles. It then sets a NullHandle at index 0, replacing the default handle with a new instance of CH.ifa.draw.standard.NullHandle.
properties.howToUse: Call handles() to get a vector of handles for the line connection.
postConditions: The handles vector contains a NullHandle at index 0 and the rest are the default handles returned by super.handles().
preConditions: A PertDependency object exists.
properties.returns: A vector of handles for the line connection.

properties.docComment: Adds a listener for this figure.
properties.description: Adds a listener to be notified of changes in figures within the drawing framework.
properties.howItWorks: The method registers the provided listener to receive events when figures in the drawing framework are changed. This is useful for updating UI elements or performing other actions based on changes.
properties.howToUse: Call addFigureChangeListener with a FigureChangeListener object to register it for figure change notifications.
postConditions: The listener will start receiving notifications of figure changes.
preConditions: A valid CH.ifa.draw.framework.FigureChangeListener object must be provided.

figures don't have any attributes getAttribute
returns null.

properties.howItWorks: The method returns null, indicating that no specific attribute is found for the given name.
properties.howToUse: Call the getAttribute method with a string argument to retrieve an attribute value.

properties.description: The constructor initializes the ImageFigure object by calling its superclass constructor and setting default values for fFileName, fImage, and fDisplayBox.
properties.howItWorks: The constructor calls super() to initialize the superclass AbstractFigure. It then sets the initial values of fFileName, fImage, and fDisplayBox to null.

properties.docComment: Brings a figure to the front.
properties.description: Brings a figure to the front of the drawing.
properties.howItWorks: The method retrieves the current order of figures in the drawing and moves the specified figure to the top of this list.
properties.howToUse: Call bringToFront with a CH.ifa.draw.framework.Figure object to bring it to the front of the drawing.
postConditions: The specified figure is now at the front of the drawing.
preConditions: The figure must be part of the drawing.

The handles() method in the RoundRectangleFigure class adds handles to a figure and returns them as a Vector.
properties.howItWorks: The method creates a new Vector, adds handles at each corner and the north, south, east, and west of the figure using CH.ifa.draw.standard.BoxHandleKit.addHandles, and then adds a RadiusHandle to the vector.
properties.howToUse: Call handles() on an instance of RoundRectangleFigure to get a Vector of handles.

method calling drawBackground followed by drawFrame.
properties.description: Draws the frame and background of a figure using the provided graphics context.
properties.howItWorks: The method retrieves the fill and frame colors of the AttributeFigure object. If the fill color is not transparent, it sets the graphics context to the fill color and calls drawBackground() to draw the background. Similarly, if the frame color is not transparent, it sets the graphics context to the frame color and calls drawFrame() to draw the frame.

postConditions: The figure's frame and background are drawn using the provided graphics context.

Decomposes a figure into its parts. A figure is considered
as a part of itself.
properties.description: The decompose() method in the CH.ifa.draw.framework.Figure interface is used to create a FigureEnumeration object that can be used to iterate over all subfigures of a given figure.
properties.howItWorks: This method returns an enumeration of all figures contained within the current figure, allowing for easy traversal and manipulation of the drawing components.
properties.howToUse: To use this method, simply call it on any instance of CH.ifa.draw.framework.Figure to get an enumeration of its subfigures.
postConditions: Returns a FigureEnumeration object that can be used to iterate over all subfigures of the given figure.
properties.returns: A FigureEnumeration object containing all subfigures of the given figure.

properties.howToUse: Call getMinimumSize() to retrieve the minimum size of the drawing view.
properties.returns: A java.awt.Dimension object representing the minimum size of the drawing view.

properties.description: The handles() method returns a Vector of objects that represent the handles associated with a figure in JHotDraw-5.1.

properties.howToUse: To use the handles() method, call it on an instance of CH.ifa.draw.framework.Figure.
properties.returns: A Vector containing handles for the figure, which are typically used to manipulate or interact with the figure.

properties.description: The notifyPostTasks() method iterates over a collection of PertFigure objects and updates their end durations.
properties.howItWorks: The method iterates over the elements of a collection using an Enumeration object, converts each element to a PertFigure object, and calls the updateDurations() method on it. This updates the end duration of the PertFigure object based on its start and duration values.
properties.howToUse: Call notifyPostTasks() to update the end durations of all PertFigure objects in the collection.
postConditions: The end durations of all PertFigure objects in the collection have been updated.
preConditions: A collection of PertFigure objects is initialized and populated.

properties.docComment: Executes the command.
properties.description: Handles the execution of commands from a menu item in JHotDraw-5.1.
properties.howItWorks: Iterates through the items in the menu, checks if the source of the event matches an item, and executes the corresponding command.
properties.howToUse: Called when a menu item is selected to execute a command.
postConditions: The selected command is executed.
preConditions: The menu has at least one item.

properties.docComment: Releases the figure and all its children.
properties.description: The release() method in CH.ifa.draw.standard.CompositeFigure is responsible for releasing all figures contained within the composite figure and notifying any registered FigureChangeListener that a figure has been removed from the drawing area.
properties.howItWorks: The method iterates over all figures in the composite figure using a FigureEnumeration, calls the release() method on each figure, and then notifies any registered FigureChangeListener that a figure has been removed.
properties.howToUse: Called when a figure is removed from the drawing area.
postConditions: All figures in the composite figure have been released and notified of their removal.
Any registered FigureChangeListener has been informed of the removal of all figures.
preConditions: The composite figure must be initialized and contain at least one figure.

properties.description: Returns a south-east handle for the given figure.
properties.howItWorks: Creates and returns a new SouthEastHandle instance that handles the south-east corner of the given figure.
properties.howToUse: Call southEast with a Figure object to get its south-east handle.

properties.description: Handles user interface, such as instatiating, setting properties of, or laying out widget objects and capturing user interactions.
Handles application and domain logic, i.e., neither UI nor data access.

Handles loading and storing data from/to external services (including database systems, web services, filesystems, hardware, etc.) or adjacent operations such as (de)serialization, en/decoding, format conversion, etc.
